UPDATE dan DELETE meninggalkan lifecycle: UPDATE and DELETE leave an MVCC lifecycle
Dalam PostgreSQL, UPDATE dan DELETE tida: In PostgreSQL, UPDATE and DELETE do not immediately remove old versions because another transaction's snapshot may still need to see them. A version no longer visible to the relevant snapshots can become a dead tuple. PostgreSQL can prune a page when conditions are safe, and VACUUM processes dead row versions and index entries so their space is available for reuse. “Dead” means no longer needed by the snapshots still under consideration; it is not synonymous with “created by a DELETE a few seconds ago.”
Ruang reuse biasanya dipakai oleh insert: Reusable space is usually used by a later insert or update on the same relation. Standard VACUUM generally does not shrink the main file and does not make an application immediately see host disk usage fall. Maintenance reports must therefore separate dead tuples, internal free space, object size, and OS filesystem space. A successful DELETE changes data; it is not a command to return space to the OS.
Visibility map membantu skip dan index-o: The visibility map helps skipping and index-only scans
Visibility map dapat membantu VACUUM mel: The visibility map can help VACUUM skip particular pages and help an index-only scan avoid a heap fetch when visibility is known. It is not a list of every dead tuple, a bloat measurement, or proof that a page has been compacted. A data-modifying operation can clear a bit. The worked fixture models only state and the boundary of conclusions; it does not read the `_vm` fork or inspect a page.
VACUUM FULL menulis ulang dan memiliki b: VACUUM FULL rewrites and has different costs
Standard VACUUM menjaga relation tetap d: Standard VACUUM keeps the relation usable while cleaning safe versions and marking space for reuse. VACUUM FULL writes a complete new copy with a denser layout, needs extra temporary disk, and obtains an ACCESS EXCLUSIVE lock. Because of that rewrite and blocking, VACUUM FULL is a specialized tool for significant reclaim cases, not the default cure whenever an application performs DELETE.
Jika workload akan mengisi ruang yang sa: If the workload will fill the same space again, regular standard VACUUM is usually more appropriate than repeatedly shrinking the file. An operational decision must consider dead tuples, the snapshot horizon, relation growth, workload, the lock window, and disk requirements. This lesson does not run VACUUM or claim a size change; the learner only connects the lifecycle to a maintenance choice.

Horizon lebih penting daripada label sta: The horizon matters more than the status label alone
VACUUM harus mempertahankan row version: VACUUM must retain row versions that may still be visible to a transaction snapshot. Conceptually, an older xmin horizon can retain a tuple whose transaction ID is not yet safe according to that snapshot. This is why a long-running snapshot can increase the number of dead tuples that cannot yet be reclaimed. However, “long” is not merely a wall-clock measure; the key question is whether the relevant snapshot or xmin is still alive and older than the version to be cleaned.
Status `idle in transaction` adalah siny: The `idle in transaction` status is an investigation signal, not an automatic verdict. In READ COMMITTED, a snapshot is usually tied to a statement; in repeatable-read or serializable, a snapshot can be retained longer. An idle session without an old snapshot holding the horizon must not be classified the same as an active old snapshot. Check xmin/horizon evidence and transaction mode before concluding that cleanup is blocked.
Old snapshot dapat memperbesar bloat yan: An old snapshot can increase visible bloat
Bayangkan update menghasilkan tuple baru: Imagine an update producing a new tuple and marking the old version invisible to transactions that start later. If an old transaction can still see the old version, VACUUM must be careful. During that period, the old-version space remains in the relation and bloat statistics may look worse. After the horizon moves, cleanup can become eligible; but when it happens and how much space is used still depend on page layout, update pattern, indexes, and workload.
Idle transaction perlu diagnosis dan rem: An idle transaction needs safe diagnosis and remediation
Remediation harus mempertimbangkan owner: Remediation must consider the session owner, whether the transaction is still needed, the isolation level, timeout policy, and rollback impact. Carelessly closing a connection can cancel business work or cause a retry; allowing an old snapshot to live without bound can hold back cleanup. Good observability connects the session, xmin/horizon, query, transaction age, and dead-tuple evidence before action is taken.

VACUUM FULL rewrites and needs a heavier lock; it does not fix the root cause if the next snapshot holds versions again. First decide whether the snapshot is finished, the owner must commit or roll back the transaction, or the workload needs a boundary. This lesson compares states; it does not run a session kill, VACUUM, or timeout change.

Freeze berbicara tentang transaction age: Freezing is about transaction age, not the clock
Transaction IDs memiliki umur dalam juml: Transaction IDs have an age measured in transactions. When relfrozenxid or row age approaches a configured limit, vacuum can be forced to prevent transaction-ID wraparound. Anti-wraparound maintenance has integrity priority; an ordinary autovacuum disable must not be treated as a way to remove that need. Transaction age 210000 in the model does not mean 210000 seconds or a particular date.
Freezing menandai tuple lama agar visibi: Freezing marks old tuples so transaction-ID visibility remains safe; it is not DELETE of historical rows, automatic pruning of every dead tuple, or VACUUM FULL. An all-frozen page can help a later vacuum skip it until the page changes, but that is not proof of filesystem shrink. This vocabulary distinction matters so engineers do not mix correctness safety with bloat compaction.

Jangan mematikan autovacuum secara globa: Do not disable autovacuum globally as a shortcut, and do not immediately change the scale factor without a baseline. Do not run VACUUM FULL only because age is high: FULL rewrites and locks, while anti-wraparound may need ordinary vacuum/freezing. VACUUM memelihara visibility map dengan: VACUUM maintains a visibility map with all-visible and all-frozen bits per heap page. The all-visible bit says that tuples on the page are known visible to all active and future transactions until the page changes. The all-frozen bit says tuples are frozen for transaction-ID visibility purposes. The VM is conservative: a set bit is positive evidence, while an unset bit does not prove that a page has dead tuples. Live frozen tuples remain visible; freezing does not delete or hide a business row. The fixture frozen_page row represents those live tuples.
Bloat bukan satu angka universal. View s: Bloat is not one universal number. Statistics views can provide row or dead-tuple estimates, while page/object size has another scope. Dataset V2 deliberately uses XID numbers and eligibility flags authored for practice. It does not reproduce pg_stat_activity, pg_stat_user_tables, pg_class, or two engine sessions.
